Executive Vice President - Chief Operating Officer

Age 60; 30+ years in consumer financial services, fintech, payments, lending, digital banking. Prior roles include SVP & Global Head of Financial Services at PayPal; CEO of Aisling Consulting and iCreditWorks; Managing Director at Goldman Sachs; senior roles at Citigroup, Barclays, GE Capital, MBNA. Georgetown bachelor’s degree.
